answer: Exactly the listed Open Ambiguity (task-rw-f5-output-renderer.md:74; status:blocked line 3) and inventory pending-decision #4 (deskops-rewrite-inventory.md:219-220): A) keep per-command shapes or B) wrap in {ok:true,data:...}. Do not choose.

Task:52 '<command path joined by _>' omits whether the deskops prefix is included and how segments/args map; sibling convention uses a prog prefix (task-rw-f1-output-golden-files.md:63 'help/deskops_<sub>[_<subsub>].txt'). Fix: pin e.g. output/deskops_list_tasks.json, no flags/positional args.

--format yaml already exists for inbox/message/faq (parser.py:551,599,644), but other commands are text|json only (parser.py:909). DoD (task:66) demands yaml goldens for every --format command. Fix: scope yaml goldens to yaml-capable commands, or extend their choices.

Per-command, not global: root parser defines no --format (parser.py:21-47). Default 'text'. Choices text|json via _add_output_format_argument (parser.py:906-912); text|json|yaml ad hoc at parser.py:551 (inbox), :599 (message), :644 (faq).

Only 'runtime supervise' is named; no rule for which commands stream or how bypass is detected. Fix: define bypass as handlers that write incrementally and return no payload, list them (today only runtime supervise), and test one.

Goal (task:38) defines the envelope only for --format json; text/yaml error behavior is unstated (today errors go to stderr, main.py:374-392). Fix: state text/yaml keep today's plain stderr behavior and add a case asserting no envelope.
Owned by the F1 sibling: '--update-golden (registered in tests/conftest.py)' is a pytest option (task-rw-f1-output-golden-files.md:55,64,83); conftest.py does not exist yet. Implement it there.

deskops/errors.py does not exist (find: no match); unexpected exceptions today raise SystemExit('Unexpected: ...') (main.py:392). Fix: state type is the raised class __name__ for every non-argparse error (typed or unexpected) and test it.

No fixture/normalization rule for the golden harness: non-deterministic paths/timestamps and empty/missing roots are unaddressed. F1 already solves this with a fixed fixture desk and <root>/<ts>/<sha> normalization (task-rw-f1-output-golden-files.md:56-63). Fix: reuse it.

Commit granularity is the supervisor's, not the executor's: Resolved Decisions (task doc) say the executor does not commit and the supervisor makes the closeout commit, so init/port/envelope boundaries are not an execution decision.

Dependency is unsatisfied: task-rw-f5-root-resolution-and-sandbox-guard.md:3 is status: deferred (not closed) and itself depends_on task-rw-f5-command-registry (line 5); this task's blocked status is correct.

No normalization needed today: operations._print_json uses json.dumps without sort_keys (operations.py:324), preserving insertion order, and yaml.safe_dump(sort_keys=False) (message.py:256). Both are deterministic.

Uniform: every subcommand's parse error raises SystemExit from parser.parse_args (main.py:57) and is caught before any handler/--format at main.py:58-62, so argparse stderr+exit 2 is identical for all subcommands.

Accepted sets differ today (text|json via parser.py:909; text|json|yaml at parser.py:551/599/644), so whether every --format command must support all three is unstated. Fix: extend all to yaml, or scope Done When (task:66) to each command's offered formats.
